Dear Sir/Madam,

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations, we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors
(“Board”) of Aerpace Industries Limited (“the Company”), at its meeting held on October 19, 2026, has, inter alia,
considered and approved:
1.

The Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) alongwith Limited Review Reports issued by the
Statutory Auditors of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
The copy of the said Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company along with the Limited
Review Reports, are enclosed as “Annexure A”.

2.

Based on the recommendation of Audit Committee, the Board approved and recommended for
shareholders’ approval the proposal for variation in the objects of the Preferential Issue and re-allocation of
the unutilized proceeds, by way of special resolution at the ensuing General Meeting or through postal
ballot, in accordance with the Companies Act, 2013, SEBI Listing Regulations, SEBI (Issue of Capital and
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018.
The Board had, on September 26, 2026, allotted 1,50,00,000 convertible warrants to N. K. Family Private

Trust, an entity belonging to the Promoter Group, on a preferential basis at an issue price of 332.55 per
warrant, aggregating to ¥48,82,50,000, upon receipt of 25% of the issue price as upfront consideration
(“Preferential Issue”). The proceeds of the Preferential Issue were intended to be utilised towards working
capital requirements.
The proposed variation covers the balance consideration receivable upon conversion of the warrants into
equity shares. Subject to shareholders’ approval, these proceeds are proposed to be utilised in the following

manner:

Accordingly, the Company proposes to re-allocate an aggregate amount of 330.00 crores from the proceeds
of the Preferential Issue, out of total amount of ¥36.62 crores to be received from balance consideration

receivable upon conversion of the warrants into equity shares, comprising ¥15.00 crores towards Capital
expenditure requirements and 315.00 crores towards repayment of loan. The remaining amount of 36.62
crores shall continue to be utilised towards the original objects of the Preferential Issue, as disclosed in the
Offer Letter and the Explanatory Statement annexed to the Postal Ballot Notice dated July 9, 2026 &
Corrigendum to the Notice of Postal Ballot dated July 20, 2026.
The proposed variation aims to align the utilisation of the Preferential Issue proceeds with the Company’s
current business requirements and operational priorities and facilitate efficient deployment of capital. The
proposed re-allocation is confined to the aforesaid proceeds and does not involve any fresh fund raising
beyond the consideration receivable under the existing Preferential Issue.
The details as required under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations read with applicable SEBI
circulars are enclosed as Annexure B.
The meeting commenced at 03:00 p.m. and concluded at 6:00 p.m.
The above information can be accessed on the website of the Company at www.aerpace.com.
This is for your information and records.
Thanking You,
For Aerpace Industries Limited
